final: WITH category_averages AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(ili.product_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(ABS(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost)) AS average_cost_difference FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id JOIN Product_Categories AS pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description), category_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_cost_difference) AS mean_cost_difference FROM category_averages) SELECT AVG(c.average_quantity), AVG(c.average_cost_difference), AVG(c.average_cost_difference - m.mean_cost_difference) FROM category_averages AS c CROSS JOIN category_mean AS m WHERE c.average_cost_difference > m.mean_cost_difference
